query:
SELECT r.firstName, r.lastName, p.id, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.startDate, p.endDate, p.isActive
FROM residents r
JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC;
